name: retrieval-search-documents
title: Retrieval: Hermes with Claude Haiku 5.5 without (A) and with a document search tool (B), 10 document tasks and 4 controls x 10
description: The retrieval run set out before it started (docs/experiment.md, Validation: retrieval, a document search tool; D79). Both arms are the headline's v2 config; arm B adds search_documents, keyword search over Kaveri Bank's (fictional) documents and a cited November 2026 bulletin. B passes 84.3% against A's 28.6%, +55.7 points (95% interval +34.3 to +77.1), sign-flip p = 0.0020 over 14 tasks; 6 tasks flagged beyond noise, all among the 10 predicted, and the 4 controls 10 of 10 in both arms. Without the documents the agent states a made-up rate or fee in 42 of 100 trials and declines or misses without inventing in 58. Regraded once after a grader fix (a rate a tool returned as value and unit was counted as made up); the verdict did not move.
experiment_name: Retrieval: without (A) vs with search_documents (B), Hermes, Claude Haiku 5.5, 10 document tasks + 4 controls x 10
